subject: Mathematics

source.topic: This is where people live: Numeracy
source.subtopic: Theme-related subtraction story sums with 10 counters (e.g. Bob has 8 nails, hammers 4)

show.line: Builders use nails! Eight nails. Bob hammers four. Four nails are left.

rounds.story: Bob has eight nails. He hammers four into the wood. How many nails are left?
rounds.praise: Four! Eight take away four is four.

rounds.prompt: Ten bricks. The builder uses three. Count the bricks that are left.

rounds.story: Thuli paints six doors. Two are already dry. How many doors are still wet?
rounds.praise: Four! Six take away two is four.

rounds.prompt: Nine planks. Four are used for the roof. How many are left? Say the number.
Five buckets of water. Two are empty. How many buckets are still full?

rounds.story: Ten tiles on the roof. The wind blows one off. How many tiles are left on the roof?
rounds.praise: Nine! Ten take away one is nine.

hints: Take away means some are gone. Count what is left.
Cover the ones that are used. Count the rest.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Eight nails. I hammer four.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Eight take away four. Six nails are left!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Four were hammered in, so four are left.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count what is left together. One, two, three, four nails!

parent_line: Can solve taking away stories up to 10.
